summary.zh-CN: 用语音开始输入，通过 CLI 管理模型，并让大型会话加载与工具记录更加可靠。
summary.en-US: Start with your voice, manage models from the CLI, and load large sessions with more reliable tool history.

title.zh-CN: 语音输入与对象级 CLI

body.zh-CN: 点击即可录音，桌面端可选按住说话；转录文字写入当前光标位置并保留为草稿，不会自动发送。
body.en-US: Click to record or optionally use desktop push-to-talk. Transcribed text is inserted at the cursor and remains a draft instead of being sent automatically.

title.zh-CN: 从 CLI 管理模型与搜索
title.en-US: Manage models and search from the CLI

body.zh-CN: 通过 nextclaw CLI 管理提供商、发现和配置模型、测试连接、授权受支持的提供商、选择默认模型并配置网页搜索。
body.en-US: Use the nextclaw CLI to manage providers, discover and configure models, test connections, authorize supported providers, choose a default model, and configure web search.

title.zh-CN: 更快、更清楚的聊天体验

body.zh-CN: 会话摘要直接复用索引数据，实时状态变化不再反复刷新整页列表。
body.en-US: Session summaries reuse indexed data, and live status changes no longer refresh the entire list repeatedly.

title.zh-CN: 模型和移动端布局更顺手

body.zh-CN: 收藏与最近模型优先显示，其余按提供商分组；手机聊天为消息正文释放更多空间。
body.en-US: Favorites and recent models appear first, remaining models are grouped by provider, and mobile chat leaves more room for message text.

title.zh-CN: 状态、工具记录与连接修复
title.en-US: Status, tool history, and connection fixes

title.zh-CN: 任务结束状态及时同步

body.zh-CN: 任务完成后不再残留“正在思考”，已处理消息会保留耗时，并在刷新后继续显示。
body.en-US: Finished tasks no longer remain stuck on Thinking, and completed messages preserve their elapsed time across refreshes.

title.zh-CN: 工具历史和终端输出可靠显示
title.en-US: Reliable tool history and terminal output

body.zh-CN: 刷新后不会重复多轮工具消息或持续等待，成功命令会显示 stdout、stderr 等终端内容。
body.en-US: Refreshes no longer duplicate multi-step tool messages or leave endless waits, and successful commands show terminal output such as stdout and stderr.

title.zh-CN: 移动端自动恢复实时连接

body.zh-CN: 页面重新可见或网络恢复时会替换失效连接，并补齐会话与任务状态。
body.en-US: When the page becomes visible or the network returns, stale connections are replaced and session and task state are synchronized.
